name: viewfinder
description: Inspect, edit, profile, capture, and orchestrate Iris shaderpacks in a running Minecraft client.

interface.shortDescription: Debug and automate a live Iris shaderpack.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Viewfinder's local MCP server for queued shader workflows, pack and config switching, diagnostics, GPU profiling, resource inspection, captures, source edits, and controlled singleplayer scenes.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose the active shaderpack and prioritize fresh compiler errors.
Profile 120 warmed frames and identify the slowest Iris passes.
Capture and inspect a named shader pass without interleaving.
